annotations.target_phrase: Night City was like a deranged experiment in social Darwinism
annotations.annotation_text: Gibson's description of Night City as a hyper-capitalist borderzone where technological obsolescence meets unregulated black markets, anticipating Mike Davis's concept of urban dystopias.
sources: Gibson, William. Neuromancer. Ace Books, 1984, p. 8.

annotations.annotation_text: The video arcade serves as the training ground and somatic precursor for cyberspace navigation, linking arcade motor reflexivity directly to the console cowboy archetype.
sources: Bukatman, Scott. Terminal Identity. Duke UP, 1993.

annotations.annotation_text: Linda Lee represents Case's fragile emotional tether to unmediated human affection in the meat world, whose murder in Chiba catalyzes his guilt and descent.
sources: Gibson, William. Neuromancer. Ace Books, 1984, p. 8.
